title: Bentwaters guards see multicolor disc retracting a rod

tellings.quote: couple of guys on the record saying that there was an object that was a multicolor disc quite near them quite large

plain: In 1980, guards at RAF Bentwaters, an air base in England, are said to have seen a large disc in many colours quite close to them, an object that, as the story goes, pulled a rod back into itself. The researcher Robert Hastings tells it on Michels's show, saying a couple of the men have gone on the record about it, though he does not name his source. He gives it as part of his case that UFOs keep watch over nuclear weapons bases around the world.
